title: A clarification of frequently misused terminology in restorative dentistry
html: Clear communication is essential in restorative dentistry. Using correct terminology enhances collaboration, documentation, and research. We aim to report several examples of common pitfalls in terminology use within the dental community that continually lead to clinical errors and misunderstandings and negatively affect patient comprehension and consent. We focused on 5 terminology pairs that are often misused in the literature and in marketing, thereby confusing clinical decision making. This ambiguity is not just theoretical; it has fundamental clinical importance.
